title.zh-CN: 【TDengine】您的 IDMP 免费版测点数量已超过 {tagLimit} 上限，请及时处理
title.en: [TDengine] Your IDMP Free Edition has exceeded the {tagLimit} Tag limit

content.zh-CN:
{userName}，您好：

感谢您使用 TDengine IDMP 免费版。

涛思数据面向符合条件的中小企业永久免费提供 TDengine 免费版——它与商业版在功能、性能与系统架构上完全一致，唯一的功能限制是测点数量不超过 {tagLimit} 个。测点是指一个单一观测指标的时序数据流，例如一台空压机的出口温度、一条产线的蒸汽压力。

系统检测到，您当前使用的免费版测点数量已达到 {currentNum} 个，超过了 {tagLimit} 个的上限，请即时处理。

如果您的业务规模已经超出这一范围，建议您升级到商业版，以获得不受测点数量限制的软件授权，并享有涛思数据官方技术支持与服务等级承诺。

从免费版升级到商业版非常简单，您无需重新部署，也无需迁移数据，只需更换商业版软件许可后即可生效，您现有免费版中的所有数据、配置、面板与分析任务都会完整保留。

如需升级或了解商业版详情，请通过以下方式联系我们：

  • 官网：https://www.taosdata.com
  • 免费版政策说明：https://www.taosdata.com/tdengine-free-edition
  • 咨询邮箱：sales@taosdata.com
  • 咨询电话：400-6120 020

感谢您对 TDengine 的信任与支持！

涛思数据
content.en:
Dear {userName},

Thank you for using TDengine IDMP Free Edition.

TDengine Free Edition is identical to the Commercial Edition in functionality, performance and architecture, with only one functional limitation: a tag limit of {tagLimit}. A tag refers to the time-series data stream of a single observed metric — for example, the discharge temperature of an air compressor or the steam pressure of a production line.

Our system has detected that your TDengine Free Edition has reached {currentNum} Tags, exceeding the {tagLimit}-Tag limit. Please address this promptly.

If your business has outgrown this scale, we recommend upgrading to the Commercial Edition, which removes the tag limit and includes official technical support and a service-level agreement.

Upgrading is quite simple: no redeployment or data migration is required. Simply replace the software license with a Commercial Edition license and the upgrade takes effect immediately. All your data, configurations, dashboards and analysis tasks in the Free Edition are fully preserved.

To upgrade or learn more about the Commercial Edition, please contact us:

  • Website: https://tdengine.com/
  • Free Edition policy: https://tdengine.com/free-tier/
  • Email: support@tdengine.com

Thank you for your trust in TDengine.

Taos Technology LLC (TDengine)
